Our 20,000+ m² facility with ISO 9001 quality management documents available upon request houses dedicated production lines for PP melt-blown sediment filters, sintered CTO carbon block filters, GAC granular carbon, T33 post-carbon, UF hollow-fiber membranes, and the full RO membrane element family from 50 GPD residential to 600 GPD commercial. Today we proudly supply over 50 countries with NSF/ANSI 42, 53 and 58 compliant products, holding CE, SGS, food-grade material declarations, quality documents and Halal-related documents available upon request certifications for international compliance. documents.text: Abubuwan fasahar carbon da aka kunna Cibiyar Ilimin Carbon Mai Kunnawa Koyi yadda ake zaɓar carbon da aka kunna daga ruwa ko rahoton-ruwa mai tsari, mahaɗan manufa, kwarara, yanayin lamba, kayan aiki da shaida. Yuchen Water yana ba da kayan aikin carbon da aka kunna da harsashi kuma yana ba da tallafin fasaha na kayan aiki masu alaƙa. Wannan cibiyar tana bayyana hanyar yanke shawara ba tare da tambayar masu siye su zaɓi samfur da farko ba. Aika Rahoton Ruwa don Duban Carbon da Aka Kunna Cibiyar Ilimin Membrane Shawarwari na abu ya zo bayan rahoton, kimantawar fasaha da mahallin kayan aiki-ba a gabansu ba. Rahoton ruwa ko tsari-ruwa Haɗarin fasaha da bitar shaida Kunna-carbon abu shugabanci Kayan aiki da kuma kula da wasa Taimakon aiki da sauyawa Misalin tunani. Ba sakamakon gwaji, takaddun samfur ko zanen injiniya ba. Rahoton-tsari na bita na fasaha na farko Aika rahoton Samar da tushen-ruwa ko tsarin-ruwa bayanan, mahaɗan manufa, ingancin fitarwa da ake buƙata, kwarara da yanayin aiki. Yi nazarin kasada Raba aikin adsorption daga daskararru, ma'adanai, oxidants, yanayin halittu da sauran buƙatun jiyya. Ƙayyade hanyar carbon Kwatanta kafofin watsa labarai, GAC tasoshin, CTO tubalan, UDF harsashi, T33 gogewa ko PAC ana yin allurai kawai bayan aikin ya bayyana. Match kayan da kayan aiki Tabbatar da shaidar da ke akwai, ƙayyadaddun bayanai, gidaje ko jirgin ruwa, riga-kafi, kulawa da tsarin sabis. Taimakawa aiki da sauyawa Samar da wadata, bitar daftarin aiki, jagorar fasaha mai nisa da shirin maye gurbin a cikin iyakar da aka yarda. Hanyoyin aikace-aikace Municipal da ruwan sha Bincika abubuwan da ke da iskar oxygen, abubuwan dandano da wari, kwayoyin halitta, kwarara da ainihin shaidar da ake buƙata don harsashi ko tsarin da aka tsara. Ruwan karkashin kasa da ruwan rijiya Bincika ma'adanai, karafa, turbidity, kwayoyin halitta da yanayin halittu kafin sanya wani matsayi ga carbon. Tsarin masana'antu ruwa Ƙayyade mahaɗin da aka yi niyya, canjin tsari, yanayin lamba, aikin jirgin ruwa da saka idanu na nasara. RO da NF pretreatment Yi la'akari da ko kunna carbon yana yin bayani game da abin da aka rubuta oxidant ko haɗarin kwayoyin halitta da kuma yadda za a kiyaye matakin. Ruwan sharar gida da sake amfani Yi amfani da cikakken ilimin kimiyyar rafi da tarihin aiwatarwa; carbon na iya zama mataki ɗaya a cikin jirgin magani mafi girma. OEM da masu tacewa Daidaita ginin, girma, haɗi, kwarara, shaida da shirin sabis maimakon zaɓi daga lakabin shi kaɗai. Jagoran carbon da aka kunna mai alaƙa Albarkatu Carbon Mai Kunnawa a cikin Jiyya na Ruwa: Rahoton-Jagora ta Farko Fahimtar inda carbon da aka kunna ya dace a cikin maganin ruwa, abin da ba zai iya kafawa da kansa ba, da kuma menene bayanan ruwa mai kaya ke buƙata kafin ba da shawarar tsarin carbon. Karanta jagorar → Albarkatu GAC vs CTO vs PAC vs UDF vs T33: Yadda Tsarin Carbon Ya bambanta Kwatanta tsarin carbon da aka kunna ta hanyar shigarwa, tsarin lamba, halin matsin lamba, hanyar sabis da buƙatun shaida maimakon ɗaukar sunayensu azaman masu musanyawa. Karanta jagorar → Albarkatu Yadda Ake Karanta Kayan Karɓar Carbon Raw-Material da Ƙayyadaddun Gwaji Koyi yadda ya kamata a karanta ƙayyadaddun ƙayyadaddun carbon-harsashi-kwakwa, tushen kwal da itace, lambar aidin, raga, ash, damshi da taurin ya kamata a karanta ba tare da mayar da su cikin iƙirarin ayyuka marasa tallafi ba. Karanta jagorar → Albarkatu Masana'antu GAC Zane: EBCT, Nasara da Kulawa Dubi yadda kwarara, ƙarar gado, EBCT, asarar matsa lamba, sa ido kan nasara, daidaitawar jirgin ruwa da tsarin sabis suna siffata aikin granular da aka kunna carbon. Karanta jagorar → Albarkatu Carbon Mai Kunnawa da PFAS: Yadda Ake Karanta Shaidar Bita PFAS da'awar don kunna carbon ta fili, matrix ruwa, yanayin gado, ƙarshen gwaji, iyakar takaddun shaida da buƙatun kiyayewa ba tare da ƙaddamar da sakamako ɗaya ga kowane samfur ba. Karanta jagorar → Albarkatu Maye gurbin Tacewar Carbon da Gyara matsala Gano gajiyawar carbon-tace, ci gaba, tashoshi, tara kuɗi, asarar matsa lamba, tsangwama da gibin tsarin sabis ta amfani da saka idanu da shaidar tsarin maimakon tazarar kalandar duniya. Karanta jagorar → RO Cibiyar Ilimin Membrane Ci gaba ta hanyar gungun ilimin, duba zaɓaɓɓun shaidar samfur kawai a cikin iyakokin da aka bayyana, kwatanta tsarin samfur, ko ƙaddamar da rahoton don nazarin fasaha. Karanta jagorar → Shaidar gwaji da aka zaba Yi bitar shaidar gwajin da aka zaɓa Waɗannan kafofin sun bayyana ƙa'idodin jiyya ko iyakokin takaddun shaida. Ba sa tabbatar da samfuran Yuchen Water kuma basa maye gurbin takamaiman shaida na aikin. Yi bitar shaidar gwajin da aka zaɓa → Yadda Yuchen Water ke tallafawa aikin nazarin rahoton ruwa da tsari-ruwa kunnawa-carbon kafofin watsa labarai da harsashi shugabanci pretreatment, gidaje, jirgin ruwa da kayan aiki tattaunawa fasaha ƙayyadaddun ƙayyadaddun halin yanzu da tabbatar da shaidar da akwai kayan aiki da kayan aiki shigarwa mai nisa, ƙaddamarwa da jagorar kulawa shirin maye gurbin da goyon bayan fasaha na tallace-tallace Jagororin tsarin samfur GAC / UDF CTO T33 Kayayyaki Idan babu cikakken rahoto, Yuchen Water zai iya gano gwaje-gwajen da suka ɓace kuma ya ba da jagora na farko kawai. Abu na ƙarshe, tsarin kayan aiki da tushen sabis yana buƙatar bayanan da aka sake dubawa da shaidar yanzu. Aika Rahoton Ruwa don Duban Carbon da Aka Kunna Aika rahoton ruwa ko tsari-ruwa, maƙasudin magani, kwarara da yanayin aiki. Za mu sake nazarin wadatar kayan carbon da aka kunna da tallafin kayan aiki masu alaƙa ba tare da tambayarka don zaɓar samfur ba. Aika Rahoton Ruwa don Duban Carbon da Aka Kunna Tambayoyin da ake yawan yi Shin ina buƙatar zaɓar GAC ko CTO kafin in tuntuɓar Yuchen Water? A'a. Aika tushen, manufa, kwarara, mahallin kayan aiki da rahoton samuwa. Tsarin wani ɓangare ne na bita na fasaha. Shin Yuchen Water na iya samar da kayan carbon da aka kunna kawai? Ee. Samar da kayan aiki da harsashi shine ainihin iyaka, tare da tallafin fasaha na kayan aiki masu alaƙa da akwai lokacin da ake buƙata. Shin rahoton gwaji ɗaya zai iya tallafawa kowane samfurin carbon? A'a. Shaidar gwaji ta shafi samfurin da aka gano kawai, gini, hanya da yanayi. Shin za a iya ba da garantin bincike ta Google, Yandex ko bincike AI? A'a. Shafukan suna ba da bayanan da za'a iya rarrafe, tsararru, bayanan gida, amma ba za'a iya tabbatar da firikwensin dandali na waje ko yanke shawara ba.

documents.text: Hanyar farko kawai Kunnawar Fasahar Fasahar Carbon Kada a zaɓi samfurin carbon. Bayar da matsalar jiyya, rahoton halin yanzu, aikin hydraulic da mahallin kayan aiki. Yuchen Water zai gano jagorar kayan, bacewar shaida da tambayoyin kayan aiki masu alaƙa. Aika Rahoton Ruwa don Duban Carbon da Aka Kunna Cibiyar Ilimin Membrane Shawarwari na abu ya zo bayan rahoton, kimantawar fasaha da mahallin kayan aiki-ba a gabansu ba. Rahoton ruwa ko tsari-ruwa Haɗarin fasaha da bitar shaida Kunna-carbon abu shugabanci Kayan aiki da kuma kula da wasa Taimakon aiki da sauyawa Misalin tunani. Ba sakamakon gwaji, takaddun samfur ko zanen injiniya ba. Abin da za a aika Aika rahoton ruwa ko tsari-ruwa, mahaɗar manufa, kwarara da yanayin aiki don kayan aiki-carbon da aka kunna da bitar tallafin kayan aiki. Ba tare da rahoton wakilci da ƙayyadaddun manufa ba, jagora na farko kawai zai yiwu. Kayayyakin ƙarshe, kayan aiki da tsarin sabis suna buƙatar shaidar da aka sake dubawa. Cibiyar Ilimin Carbon Mai Kunnawa Carbon Mai Kunnawa a cikin Jiyya na Ruwa: Rahoton-Jagora ta Farko GAC vs CTO vs PAC vs UDF vs T33: Yadda Tsarin Carbon Ya bambanta Wane rahoto da bayanan aiki ake buƙata Tambayoyin da ake yawan yi Zan iya ƙaddamar da rahoton da bai cika ba? Ee. Alama bacewar ƙimar a sarari. Amsar za ta kasance ta farko kuma tana iya ba da shawarar ƙarin bincike da ake buƙata. Shin Yuchen Water zai zaɓi samfur daga TDS kawai? A'a. TDS bai bayyana aikin talla ba. Ana iya buƙatar mahaɗan manufa, kwayoyin halitta, oxidants, barbashi, kwarara da yanayin kayan aiki. Za a iya haɗa tallafin kayan aiki? Ee. Yuchen Water na iya tattauna harsashi masu dacewa, gidaje, tasoshin, pretreatment da goyan bayan fasaha bayan an fahimci aikin.

documents.headings: Nemi littafin Commercial RO water purifier Duba littafin kan layi bayan aika bayanan mai siye
documents.text: Nemi littafin Commercial RO water purifier Wannan kallon kan layi mai kariya ne ga masu saye na B2B da ke nazarin ayyukan RO 400G, 600G, 800G da 1200G. Shigar littafi mai kariya Duba littafin kan layi bayan aika bayanan mai siye Littafin ya ƙunshi shigarwa, tsarin sassa, warware matsala, shigar membrane RO, tsaro da bayanan sabis. Duk buƙata tana zuwa Yuchen Water don taimakon ƙayyadewa da farashi. An shirya littafin a matsayin kallo kan layi. Ba a ba da PDF ga jama’a ba; kwafi, danna dama, zaɓin rubutu da jan hoto an takaita su.

documents.headings: FAQ
documents.text: 📞 +86-19908311885 · ✉ expresswater025@gmail.com Jumla ta Duniya · Tun 1998 FAQ FAQ Amsoshi masu amfani ga masu siyan tace ruwa na OEM/ODM: takaddun shaida, MOQ, lokacin samarwa, tsarin RO, kayan tacewa, jigilar duniya da tallafin bayan-tallace. Shin tace na Yuchen Water suna da takaddun shaida na NSF, CE, ISO da SGS? Za a iya samarwa ko gwada wasu kayayyaki bisa NSF/ANSI 42, 53 da 58. Takardun ISO 9001, CE, SGS da Halal suna samuwa bisa buƙata. Menene mafi ƙarancin yawan oda (MOQ) don cartridge na tace ruwa na OEM/ODM? MOQ don daidaitattun 10" PP, CTO da GAC cartridge yana farawa daga guda 1,000 ga kowane SKU don kayan hannun jari, guda 3,000 don riga da aka buga wa OEM, da kuma guda 5,000 don cikakkun ODM moldings (private end-cap, custom O-ring, branded shrink-wrap). UF membrane da RO 75/100/400 GPD membrane yawanci MOQ guda 500 ne. Masu rarrabawa da ake sakawa a bango MOQ raka'a 100 ne. Ana iya yin shawarwari kan ƙananan oda na gwaji don sababbin masu rarrabawa. A ina masana'antar ku take kuma masu saya za su iya ziyarta? Cibiyar masana'antunmu tana cikin Yuanhua Town, Haining City, Zhejiang Province, China — kimanin mintuna 90 ne ta mota daga Filin Jirgin Sama na Shanghai Hongqiao (SHA) da Filin Jirgin Sama na Hangzhou Xiaoshan (HGH). Ginin mai murabba'in m² 20,000+ yana dauke da layukan extrusion na PP melt-blown na musamman, naurorin matsa CTO carbon block da aka sintera, dakunan taro na UF/RO membrane, da layukan taro na SMT na masu rarrabawa. Muna maraba da ziyarar masu saya da aka tsara, binciken wasu (SGS, BV, TÜV) da dubawar cancantar OEM. Wane lokacin jagora (lead time) zan yi tsammani don odar sarari? Daidaitattun cartridge na PP, CTO, GAC da T33 a cikin launukan hannun jari ana jigilar su tsakanin kwanaki 7–10. Cartridge na OEM mai lakabin kansu tare da bugawa na musamman: kwanaki 20–25 daga amincewa da aikin fasaha. Abubuwan RO/UF membrane: kwanaki 15–20. Masu rarrabawa a bango da na kan tebur: kwanaki 30–45 dangane da yadda aka tsara su. Loda kwantena yawanci 1 × 20'GP (≈ cartridge 80,000) ko 1 × 40'HQ (≈ masu rarrabawa 200) ne. FOB Shanghai ko Ningbo; akwai sharuɗɗan CIF, CFR da DDP. Kuna samar da RO membrane don amfanin gida da na kasuwanci? Haka ne. Muna ba da cikakken kewayon reverse osmosis membranes: 50 GPD, 75 GPD, 100 GPD, 200 GPD, 400 GPD, 600 GPD don tsarin gida na ƙarƙashin sink, tare da abubuwan high-rejection na 300 GPD, 400 GPD da 600 GPD don masu rarraba ruwa na kasuwanci. Akwai abubuwan masana'antu na 4040 da 8040 (kamar BW30, SW30) don tsire-tsire masu maganin ruwa, dialysis, kurkure semiconductor da aikace-aikacen harhada magunguna. Adadin kin gishiri ≥ 96–99%. Menene bambanci tsakanin PP melt-blown, CTO carbon block da GAC granular activated carbon filters? PP melt-blown sediment filters suna amfani da fiber na polypropylene da aka haɗa da zafi don cire datti (tsatsa, yashi, silt) daga 0.5 zuwa 50 microns. CTO carbon block filters da aka sintera (Chlorine, Taste & Odor) suna amfani da garwashin kwakwa da aka danne ko carbon na kwal don cire chlorine mai kyauta, chloramines, VOCs, pesticides da kuma inganta ɗanɗano — yawanci 5 µm ko 10 µm. GAC granular activated carbon filters suna amfani da garwashin carbon don tsawon lokacin tuntuɓar chlorine adsorption kuma galibi sune mataki na biyu a cikin tsarin RO mai mataki 5. Muna kera duka ukun a sikelin masana'antu tare da cikakken bincike. Kuna iya samar da samfuran tace ruwa masu takardar shaidar halal don kasuwannin Musulmi? Haka ne. Mu ne mai samar da tace ruwa na halal da aka sani a hukumance tare da takardar shaidar Halal-related documents. Dukkanin kafofin watsa labarai na tace (activated carbon, mineral balls, KDF, ion-exchange resin) da kayan haɗin da ke hulɗa da abinci suna bin ka'idodin halal. Muna fitarwa akai-akai zuwa Malaysia, Indonesia, Saudi Arabia, UAE, Qatar, Egypt, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Turkey, Morocco da sauran kasuwannin Musulmi tare da takaddun halal. Kuna samar da OEM/ODM na musamman don masu rarraba ruwa da masu tsabtace ruwa? Tabbas — OEM/ODM shine babban aikinmu. Muna tsara: kalar harsashi na waje (matching na Pantone), tambarin gaba ta siliki-screen ko laser engraving, yaren LED display da UI, ƙarfin wutar lantarki (110V/220V/240V), nau'in plug (US/UK/EU/AU), marufi (gift box, brown carton, color sleeve), fassarar jagorar mai amfani, da kayan haɗi. Kudin kayan aiki don sababbin injection molds yawanci ana mayar da su akan girman oda ≥ 5,000. Wadanne sharuddan biyan kudi da sharuddan kasuwanci kuke karba? Daidaitattun sharuddan: 30% T/T ajiya lokacin tabbatar da oda, 70% sauran kuɗi akan kwafin B/L kafin jigilar kaya. Muna kuma karɓar L/C at sight daga manyan bankuna, Western Union da PayPal don samfuran oda ≤ USD 3,000, da Alibaba Trade Assurance ga masu siye na farko. Sharuddan kasuwanci: EXW Haining, FOB Shanghai/Ningbo, CIF, CFR, DDP da DDU suna nan dangane da tashar jiragen ruwa da incoterm. Menene tsawon rayuwar cartridge din ku na tace ruwa? Rayuwar sabis da ake tsammani ya danganta da ingancin ruwan da ke shigowa da kwararar yau da kullun: PP melt-blown sediment filter — watanni 3 zu 6; CTO carbon block — watanni 6 zu 12; GAC granular carbon — watanni 6 zu 12; T33 post-carbon — watanni 12; UF ultra-filtration membrane — watanni 24 zu 36; RO membrane element — watanni 24 zu 36; mineralization / alkaline T33 — watanni 12; cation-resin softening cartridge — watanni 6 zu 12 dangane da taurin ruwa. Alamar tunatarwa ta LED tana cikin dukkan samfuranmu na masu rarrabawa. Wadanne kasashe kuke fitarwa zuwa yanzu? Muna samarwa ga kasashe 50+ a nahiyoyi shida, tare da manyan kasuwanni a: USA, Canada, Mexico, Brazil, Argentina, UK, Germany, France, Italy, Spain, Russia, Ukraine, Poland, Turkey, Saudi Arabia, UAE, Egypt, Iran, Pakistan, India, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, Indonesia, Malaysia, Vietnam, Thailand, Philippines, South Korea, Japan, Australia, New Zealand, South Africa, Nigeria, Kenya, Tanzania, Morocco, Algeria. Ana maraba da haɗin gwiwar masu rarraba gida. Kuna samar da tallafin fasaha na tsarin reverse osmosis da sabis na bayan-tallace-tallace? Haka ne. Kowane abokin tarayya na OEM yana karɓar: cikakkun zane-zanen fasaha (PDF/DWG), jagororin taro, bidiyon shigarwa, jagororin mai amfani da harsuna da yawa (akwai harsuna 45+), jerin sassan gyara tare da lambobin PN, sadaukarwar tallafin injiniya na WhatsApp/email, da kuma garanti na watanni 12 zu 24 akan housings, membranes da sassan lantarki. Akwai tura injiniya don ƙaddamar da manyan RO na masana'antu akan ƙarin kuɗi. Shin tace naku na iya ɗaukar aikace-aikacen masana'antu masu ƙarfi? Haka ne. Muna kera SUS 304 da SUS 316L housings na tace bakin ƙarfe na abinci mai nauyin aiki har zuwa 16 bar (232 psi), tare da zaɓin 1", 1.5", 2" da 3" NPT/BSP. Big Blue 20" da 30" housings a cikin PP mai ƙarfi tare da brass-insert threads suna ɗaukar har zuwa 8.6 bar (125 psi). Ana gwada dukkan tasoshin matsa lamba a 1.5× matsa lamba kafin jigilar kaya kuma suna zuwa tare da sanarwar CE PED 2014/68/EU inda ya dace. Wadanne albarkatun ƙasa da tace kuke amfani da su? Muna amfani da kayan abinci kawai da NSF-listed: virgin polypropylene resin (babu recycled PP) don melt-blown da housings; coconut-shell activated carbon (≥ 1100 mg/g iodine value) da bituminous coal carbon don CTO/GAC; PVC da PES hollow-fiber don UF membranes; thin-film composite (TFC) polyamide don RO membranes; silicone mai darajar abinci don O-rings; SS 316L don kayan tsafta; food-contact-grade ABS da PP don housings; LG Display panels don masu rarrabawa; tabbataccen abubuwan dumama jan ƙarfe (inda ya dace). Yaya zan nemi quotation, samples ko samfurin kasida? Tuntuɓe mu ta WhatsApp a +86-19908311885 (tallafin tallace-tallace na 24/7, akwai Turanci/Sinanci/Larabci), imel expresswater025@gmail.com, ko cika fom ɗin tambaya akan shafinmu na Tuntuɓi. Da fatan za a haɗa da: samfurin da ake so (model/specification), yawa, ƙasar da za a aika, buƙatun marufi, da kowane buƙatun branding. Za a aika da cikakken PDF catalog, cikakkun takaddun shaida, bidiyon masana'anta da jerin farashi tsakanin sa'o'i 24 a ranakun aiki.

documents.text: Albarkatu Carbon Mai Kunnawa da PFAS: Yadda Ake Karanta Shaidar Bita PFAS da'awar don kunna carbon ta fili, matrix ruwa, yanayin gado, ƙarshen gwaji, iyakar takaddun shaida da buƙatun kiyayewa ba tare da ƙaddamar da sakamako ɗaya ga kowane samfur ba. Aika Rahoton Ruwa don Duban Carbon da Aka Kunna Cibiyar Ilimin Membrane Amsa kai tsaye Carbon da aka kunna zai iya zama wani ɓangare na dabarun jiyya PFAS, amma kalmar PFAS tana rufe mahaɗai da yawa kuma babu wani da'awar carbon da ta isa. Shaida dole ne ta gano mahaɗan PFAS da aka gwada, yawan matsuguni, matrix na ruwa, carbon da gama ginin, kwarara ko yanayin lamba, jadawalin samfur da ƙarshen ƙarshe. Ba pretreatment na duniya ba ne kuma baya maye gurbin sarrafa ruwa, sarrafa tauri, sarrafa ilimin halitta ko cikakken rahoton ruwa. Ana la'akari da carbon da aka kunna lokacin adsorption ko ayyukan catalytic suna magance ƙayyadadden haɗarin ruwa-ruwa. Binciken pretreatment ya kamata ya tabbatar da ko carbon ya dace, ko ana buƙatar ƙarin laka ko maganin sinadarai da kuma yadda tsarin zai gano ci gaba. Dole ne shawarar ta yi amfani da shaidar yanzu don kafofin watsa labaru da aka tsara da kuma daidaitawa. documents.description: Kwatanta tsarin carbon da aka kunna ta hanyar shigarwa, tsarin lamba, halin matsin lamba, hanyar sabis da buƙatun shaida maimakon ɗaukar sunayensu azaman masu musanyawa.
documents.headings: GAC vs CTO vs PAC vs UDF vs T33: Yadda Tsarin Carbon Ya bambanta Amsa kai tsaye Fara da matsalar mai siye Wane rahoto da bayanan aiki ake buƙata Dabarun zaɓi Magani, kayan aiki da mahallin aiki Kuskuren gama gari Shaida da iyakar sabis Tushen fasaha na hukuma Jagoran carbon da aka kunna mai alaƙa Tambayoyin da ake yawan yi
documents.text: Albarkatu GAC vs CTO vs PAC vs UDF vs T33: Yadda Tsarin Carbon Ya bambanta Kwatanta tsarin carbon da aka kunna ta hanyar shigarwa, tsarin lamba, halin matsin lamba, hanyar sabis da buƙatun shaida maimakon ɗaukar sunayensu azaman masu musanyawa. Aika Rahoton Ruwa don Duban Carbon da Aka Kunna Cibiyar Ilimin Membrane Amsa kai tsaye GAC, CTO, PAC, UDF da T33 sun bayyana nau'ikan kafofin watsa labarai daban-daban, ginin harsashi ko matsayi na tsarin. GAC shine carbon da aka kunna granular da ake amfani dashi a cikin tasoshin ko harsashi. CTO yawanci yana nufin harsashin carbon-block, yayin da UDF ana yawan amfani dashi don granular-carbon cartridge. T33 yawanci yana kwatanta kwandon gogewar carbon bayan layi. PAC ana kunna carbon da aka kunna a cikin ruwa kuma an cire shi a cikin wani mataki na rabuwa. Waɗannan alamun ba su tabbatar da da'awar cirewa ba ko yin musanyawar tsarin. Zaɓin dole ne ya haɗa rahoton ruwa da mahallin manufa don tuntuɓar yanayi, kwarara, asarar matsa lamba, sarrafa barbashi, girman kayan aiki, samun damar sabis da shaidar yanzu don kafofin watsa labarai da aka tsara da ginin. Siffofin biyar suna warware tambayoyin shigarwa da sabis daban-daban; zane kwatancen jiki ne, ba matsayi na aiki ba. GAC Mai watsa labarai na jirgin ruwa CTO toshe carbon PAC kashi UDF granular cartridge T33 harsashin goge baki na layi Misalin tunani. Ba sakamakon gwaji, takaddun samfur ko zanen injiniya ba. Fara da matsalar mai siye Mai siyan OEM na iya buƙatar ƙaramin kwandon maye gurbin, matakin goge ɗanɗano na layi ko manyan kafofin watsa labarai don babban jirgin ruwan magani. Mai zanen masana'antu na iya a maimakon haka yana kwatanta ƙayyadadden gado GAC tare da tsari na PAC. Sunaye na iya kama da tsani samfurin, amma sun bayyana hanyoyi daban-daban na kawo ruwa da carbon tare. Don haka kwatancen mai amfani yana aiki: inda carbon ke zaune, yadda ruwa ke motsawa ta ko kusa da shi, yawan tuntuɓar da ake samu, da yadda ake gano ƙarancin carbon da maye gurbinsa. Haɗin kai da cikakkun bayanan gini suna da mahimmanci gwargwadon sunan mai jarida. Harsashin toshewa na iya haɗa adsorption tare da halayen tacewa ta jiki kuma yana iya ƙirƙirar bayanin matsi daban-daban daga kwancen gado mara nauyi. Harsashin granular yana buƙatar allo ko pads waɗanda ke riƙe kafofin watsa labarai da sarrafa tara. Dole ne sashin layi na T33 ya dace da kayan aiki, daidaitawa da aikin goge goge na ƙarshe. PAC yana buƙatar allurai, haɗawa, tuntuɓar juna da rabuwa da daskararrun ƙasa; ba a shigar da shi azaman na al'ada kwarara-ta harsashi. documents.text: Albarkatu Jagoran Kula da Ruwan Ƙasa da Rijiyar Ruwa Shirya ruwan ƙasa da ruwa mai rijiyar jiyya daga cikakken nazarin ma'adanai, karafa, gas, kwayoyin halitta da manufofin aiki. Hanyar da ta dace tana iya amfani da pretreatment da UF, NF ko RO ke bi, amma ba za a iya zaɓar nau'in daga bayyanar ko TDS kaɗai ba. Rahoton dakin gwaje-gwaje na wakilin, ingancin ruwa mai niyya, kwararar da ake buƙata da jadawalin aiki yakamata a sake nazari kafin Yuchen Water ya ba da shawarar kayan membrane ko tallafin kayan aiki masu alaƙa. Matsalar mai siye don warwarewa Kimiyyar sinadarai na rijiyar tana nuna ilimin ƙasa na gida, zurfin rijiyar, tsarin yin famfo da cajin yanayi. Rijiyoyin guda biyu da ke kusa da juna na iya samun ma'adanai masu sikeli daban-daban ko kuma adadin ƙarfe. Samfurin da aka ɗauka bayan matatar da ke akwai kuma na iya ɓoye haɗarin ɗanyen ruwa na gaskiya. Ya kamata masu siye su gano wurin yin samfur kuma su ba da bayanan-ruwa da ba a kula da su ba duk lokacin da zai yiwu. Aikace-aikacen yana canza shawarar. Shirye-shiryen ruwan sha, amfani da aikin gona, samar da abinci, ruwan sarrafa masana'antu da kayan aikin tukunyar jirgi ba su raba manufa ɗaya ta duniya. Takaitaccen bayanin fasaha yakamata ya bayyana duka kwararar da ake buƙata da iyakoki masu inganci waɗanda ke da matsala a ƙasa, gami da ko an shirya lalatawar ƙarshe ko gogewa. Rahoton buƙatun Rahoton mai amfani yana haɗa bayanan dakin gwaje-gwaje tare da mahallin aiki. Ya kamata ƙimomi su gano wurin samfur, raka'a, kwanan gwajin da ko suna wakiltar al'ada, ƙarami ko mafi girman yanayi. Hakanan yakamata ya gano rashin tabbas maimakon canza bayanan da suka ɓace zuwa da'awar samfur. UF na iya zama da amfani lokacin da babban ƙalubalen ya kasance ɓangarorin, colloidal ko microbiological loading, amma baya cire narkar da ma'adanai. Ana iya la'akari da NF lokacin da zaɓin tauri ko narkar da-raguwar kwayoyin halitta ya dace da manufar. RO yawanci ana la'akari da shi don raguwar narkewa-gishiri mai faɗi ko mafi girman tsaftataccen ruwa. Haƙiƙanin haɗin kai ya biyo bayan rahoton maimakon bayyananniyar gani na ruwan rijiyar. Halin ƙima, iskar oxygen da iskar gas na ƙarfe na iya canza yanayi a cikin kayan aiki. Iron ko manganese da ke narkewa a rijiyar na iya haifar da barbashi bayan iska. Carbon dioxide na iya shafar pH da gogewar ƙasa. Dole ne a sake duba waɗannan hulɗar yayin zabar magani da yanayin aiki. Matakan da aka zaɓa sun dogara da ƙayyadaddun gurɓatattun abubuwa da nau'in membrane da aka nufa. Don haka dole ne tallafin kayan aiki yayi la'akari da lanƙwan famfo, jadawalin aiki da canje-canjen ingancin ciyarwa, ba kawai fitarwa na ƙima ba. Alama wanne sakamako ya fito daga dakin gwaje-gwaje, waɗanne ƙimomi suka fito daga kayan aikin kan layi kuma waɗanne yanayi ƙididdiga ne. Haɗa raka'a da kwanakin samfur. Idan tsarin da ke akwai bai cika aiki ba, samar da tushen ƙirar asali, karatun yanzu, tarihin tsaftacewa da kwanan wata lokacin da canji ya fara bayyana. Bayanan samfur na iya canzawa, don haka ana tabbatar da ainihin kayan aiki da takaddun hukuma na yanzu yayin bita na fasaha. Narkar da taurin, silica, baƙin ƙarfe, manganese, iskar gas da kwayoyin halitta maiyuwa ba za a iya gani ba amma suna iya haifar da ƙura ko ƙura. Shin UF isasshe don tsaftace ruwan ƙasa? A duk lokacin da zai yiwu, samar da wakilcin bayanan-ruwa da ba a kula da su ba kuma a fili gano wurin yin samfur.

Shawarwari na ƙarshe yakamata ya ambaci shaidar da aka yi amfani da ita, ragowar rashin tabbas da matakin tabbatarwa na gaba. Jagorar ƙaddamarwa mai nisa da shirin maye gurbin sun fi amfani lokacin da abokin ciniki ya kiyaye sauƙi, daidaitaccen rikodin waɗannan sharuɗɗan. Bayanan samfur na iya canzawa, don haka ana tabbatar da ainihin kayan aiki da takaddun hukuma na yanzu yayin bita na fasaha. Samar da hotuna, girma, haɗin kai, cikakkun bayanan famfo, jerin tacewa na yanzu, bayanan shigar-ruwa da fitarwar da ake buƙata. documents.text: Albarkatu Gishiri-Lake Brine da Ruwan da ke da alaƙa da Lithium: Bayanan Rahoton da ake buƙata Koyi abin da aka haɗa da bayanan tsari da ake buƙata kafin tattaunawa NF, RO ko UF kayan membrane don brine-tafkin gishiri da ruwan da ke da alaƙa da lithium. Aika Rahoton Ruwa don Binciken Fasaha Jagororin ilimi masu alaƙa Amsa kai tsaye Ba za a iya tantance magudanan ruwan gishiri-takin gishiri da rafukan da ke da alaƙa da lithium daga tattarawar lithium kaɗai ba. Dole ne maƙasudin rabuwa ko maƙasudin maida hankali su kasance a bayyane. Yuchen Water na iya ba da NF, RO, UF da kayan membrane masu alaƙa da kuma ba da tallafin fasaha na kayan aiki, amma baya da'awar cikakken tsarin cire lithium ko alƙawarin dawo da lithium kafin a sake duba bayanan gwaje-gwaje da injiniyanci. Matsalar mai siye don warwarewa Brines daga tabkunan gishiri daban-daban ko matakan aiwatarwa na iya zama daban-daban ko da a lokacin da darajar lithium kanun labaran su yayi kama. Babban taro, ions multivalent, lu'ulu'u da aka dakatar, kwayoyin halitta da sauye-sauye na yanayi na iya shafar danko, sikeli, zaɓi da tsabta. Samfurin wakilci da ingantaccen hanyar nazari suna da mahimmanci. Dole ne a bayyana makasudin tsari cikin sharuddan sinadarai. Rage ƙazanta ta musamman, raba ƙungiyoyin ions, tattara rafi ko shirya abinci don wani mataki ayyuka ne daban-daban. Ya kamata a gano abubuwan da ake so da kuma abubuwan da ke ratsawa maimakon amfani da jimlar jimlar hakar lithium a matsayin ƙayyadaddun kawai. Rahoton buƙatun Rahoton mai amfani yana haɗa bayanan dakin gwaje-gwaje tare da mahallin aiki. Ya kamata ƙimomi su gano wurin samfur, raka'a, kwanan gwajin da ko suna wakiltar al'ada, ƙarami ko mafi girman yanayi. Inda rafi ya canza tare da yanayi ko ayyukan samarwa, samar da kewayon maimakon ƙimar dacewa ɗaya. samfurin samfurin da mataki mataki lithium, magnesium da dangantakar su sodium, potassium, alli, chloride da sulfate boron da sauran ƙananan nau'ikan da suka dace da aikin yawa, conductivity, pH, zazzabi da danko in akwai dakatar da lu'ulu'u, daskararru, Organics da mai Abubuwan da ake buƙata da aka riƙe da masu shiga kwararar manufa, tsarin aiki, iyakoki tsaftacewa da mataki na ƙasa Yadda ake la'akari da nau'in membrane Ya kamata yanke shawarar rukuni ya bayyana abin da ake tsammanin membrane zai riƙe, abin da zai iya wucewa, menene haɗari dole ne a sarrafa shi sama da abin da tsarin ƙasa ke buƙata. Hakanan yakamata ya gano rashin tabbas maimakon canza bayanan da suka ɓace zuwa da'awar samfur. Za a iya kimanta NF don zaɓin rabuwa lokacin da cajin ion, girman da sunadarai na membrane suka daidaita tare da manufa. Abubuwan da ke da alaƙa RO na iya tallafawa rabuwar ruwa ko maida hankali ƙarƙashin madaidaicin osmotic-matsi da ambulaf ɗin sikeli. Za a iya amfani da UF don sarrafa abubuwan da aka dakatar da su ko kuma abubuwan da ake amfani da su kafin matakan membrane. Babu ɗayan waɗannan ayyuka na aiki da ke tabbatar da sakamakon aikin ba tare da takamaiman gwajin rafi ba. Zaɓin da aka auna a ƙarƙashin abun da ke cikin brine ɗaya ba za a iya canza shi ta atomatik zuwa wani abun da ke ciki ba. Gasar ions, maida hankali, pH da zafin jiki na iya canza hali. Saboda wannan dalili, takaddun bayanai sune mafari ne, yayin da ana iya buƙatar dakin gwaje-gwaje ko shaidar matukin jirgi kafin a tabbatar da kayan don aikin da ya shafi tafkin gishiri ko lithium. Pretreatment da kayan mahallin Magani yakamata sarrafa lu'ulu'u, daskararrun da aka dakatar, mai, kwayoyin halitta da haɗarin sikelin da aka gano a cikin rahoton. Tattaunawar na iya haɗawa da daidaitawa, bayani, tacewar watsa labarai, UF, dosing da tacewa na tsaro, amma jerin sun dogara da ainihin brine da mataki na gaba na membrane. Dole ne a sake nazarin kayan aiki don matsa lamba, lalata, rufewa, zazzabi, danko da samun damar tsaftacewa. Pumps, gidaje, sarrafawa da wuraren samarwa yakamata su goyi bayan ingantaccen kimantawa na rafi. Yuchen Water na iya ba da wannan goyan bayan fasaha yayin da ya rage da farko mai samar da kayan membrane. Ba ya fitar da cikakken takaddar cirewar lithium, tabbataccen zaɓi, dawo da lithium, dawo da aikin, juyi, tsawon rayuwa ko sakamakon kasuwanci don brine da ba a bita ba. Bayan an sake nazarin rahoton, ƙungiyar za ta iya gano nau'in membrane mai dacewa, binciken da ya ɓace da kuma shaidar da ake bukata don yanke shawara na gaba. Shawarwari na iya kasancewa na farko har sai dakin gwaje-gwaje ko aikin matukin jirgi ya tabbatar da hali a ƙarƙashin ainihin abun da abokin ciniki ya tsara. Alama wanne sakamako ya fito daga dakin gwaje-gwaje, waɗanne ƙimomi suka fito daga kayan aikin kan layi kuma waɗanne yanayi ƙididdiga ne. Haɗa raka'a da kwanakin samfur. Idan tsarin da ke akwai bai cika aiki ba, samar da tushen ƙirar asali, karatun yanzu, tarihin tsaftacewa da kwanan wata lokacin da canji ya fara bayyana. Wannan yana hana sabuwar tattaunawa ta zama tushen matsalar aiki da ba a tantance ba. Bayyana bambancin maimakon aika matsakaici kawai. Kewayo yana taimaka wa ƙungiyar fasaha ta gano irin haɗarin da ke buƙatar magani, saka idanu, sakewa ko ƙarin gwaji kafin a tabbatar da wadatar kayan. Bayanan kayan aiki ya kamata ya nuna yadda membrane ya dace da cikakken tsarin. Bayanai masu fa'ida sun haɗa da zane mai sauƙi, famfo da bayanan gidaje, jerin tacewa, kayan aikin da ake da su, tsarin tsaftacewa da hotunan haɗin da ke akwai. Wannan baya tambayar abokin ciniki don tsara mafita. Yana ba Yuchen Water isassun mahallin mahallin don guje wa ba da shawarar abun da ya ci karo da kayan aikin da aka shigar. Yana iya fara gano nau'in membrane da farko kuma ya jinkirta ainihin kayan har sai an kammala bincike ko gwaji. Bayan wadata, bayanan aiki suna haifar da shaida don tallafi na gaba. Jagorar ƙaddamarwa mai nisa da shirin maye gurbin sun fi amfani lokacin da abokin ciniki ya kiyaye sauƙi, daidaitaccen rikodin waɗannan sharuɗɗan. Buƙatun kasuwanci yakamata ya bi shawarar fasaha maimakon jagorantar ta. Yawan, lokacin bayarwa da takaddun tallafi za a iya tattauna da wuri, amma ba su maye gurbin tabbatar da tushen, manufa da kayan aiki ba. Lokacin kwatanta shawarwarin mai siyarwa, duba ko kowace shawarar ta faɗi yanayin ciyarwar da aka ɗauka da manufar magani. Ƙarƙashin matsi na kanun labarai, babban sunan nau'i ko mafi kyawun bayanin fitarwa baya tabbatar da dacewa mafi kyau. Shawarwari masu kama da juna yakamata suyi amfani da rahoton iri ɗaya, kewayon zafin jiki, jadawalin aiki da makasudin samfurin-ruwa, tare da ƙima maras goyan baya da ke rabu da ingantattun hujjoji. Maganar hukuma An bayar da hanyar haɗin kan hukuma a matsayin babban tunani don nau'ikan membrane na yanzu da takaddun. Bayanan samfur na iya canzawa, don haka ana tabbatar da ainihin kayan aiki da takaddun hukuma na yanzu yayin bita na fasaha. Hanyoyin haɗin ciki suna haɗa batun fasaha zuwa shafukan tallafi na kayan aiki masu dacewa ba tare da juya abun ciki na ilimi zuwa kundin ƙira ba. Cibiyar Ilimin Membrane Aika Rahoton Ruwa don Binciken Fasaha Jagororin ilimi masu alaƙa Aika Rahoton Ruwa don Binciken Fasaha Aika rahoton ruwa ko tsari-ruwa, maƙasudin magani, fitarwa da ake buƙata da yanayin aiki. Yuchen Water zai sake duba jagorar nau'in membrane, iyakar samar da kayan aiki da tambayoyin tallafin kayan aiki masu alaƙa. Aika Rahoton Ruwa don Binciken Fasaha Tambayoyin da ake yawan yi Shin maida hankali na lithium ya isa don shawarar membrane? A'a. Ana kuma buƙatar cikakken abun da ke ciki na ion, kaddarorin jiki, gurɓatawa da maƙasudin rabuwa. Shin Yuchen Water yana ba da cikakken aikin hakar lithium? Bayar da jama'a shine samar da kayan aiki na membrane-meal da goyan bayan fasaha na kayan aiki, ba cikakkar alkawari ba. Me yasa za a buƙaci gwajin dakin gwaje-gwaje ko gwaji? Abun da ke ciki na brine yana tasiri sosai ga zaɓi, ƙima, matsa lamba osmotic da tsabta.

Lokacin kwatanta shawarwarin mai siyarwa, duba ko kowace shawarar ta faɗi yanayin ciyarwar da aka ɗauka da manufar magani. Ƙarƙashin matsi na kanun labarai, babban sunan nau'i ko mafi kyawun bayanin fitarwa baya tabbatar da dacewa mafi kyau. Shawarwari masu kama da juna yakamata suyi amfani da rahoton iri ɗaya, kewayon zafin jiki, jadawalin aiki da makasudin samfurin-ruwa, tare da ƙima maras goyan baya da ke rabu da ingantattun hujjoji. Maganar hukuma An bayar da hanyar haɗin kan hukuma a matsayin babban tunani don nau'ikan membrane na yanzu da takaddun. Bayanan samfur na iya canzawa, don haka ana tabbatar da ainihin kayan aiki da takaddun hukuma na yanzu yayin bita na fasaha. Vontron masana'antu na hukuma RO da SW Series bayyani → Jagororin ilimi masu alaƙa Ci gaba da cibiyar ilimin membrane don sauran hanyoyin ruwa-ruwa da aikace-aikace, ko aika rahoton lokacin da aka riga aka ayyana manufar magani. Hanyoyin haɗin ciki suna haɗa batun fasaha zuwa shafukan tallafi na kayan aiki masu dacewa ba tare da juya abun ciki na ilimi zuwa kundin ƙira ba. Cibiyar Ilimin Membrane Aika Rahoton Ruwa don Binciken Fasaha Jagororin ilimi masu alaƙa Aika Rahoton Ruwa don Binciken Fasaha Aika rahoton ruwa ko tsari-ruwa, maƙasudin magani, fitarwa da ake buƙata da yanayin aiki. Yuchen Water zai sake duba jagorar nau'in membrane, iyakar samar da kayan aiki da tambayoyin tallafin kayan aiki masu alaƙa. Aika Rahoton Ruwa don Binciken Fasaha Tambayoyin da ake yawan yi Shin gishiri ya isa don zaɓar nau'in membrane na ruwan teku? A'a. Zazzabi, ions, turbidity, Organics, haɗarin ilimin halitta, nau'in ci da kuma maƙasudin maƙasudi kuma ana buƙatar. Shin Yuchen Water na iya tallafawa kayan aikin sanyaya da kuma kayan membrane? Ee. Taimako na iya rufe jagorar pretreatment, gidaje masu jituwa, famfo, tacewa, sarrafawa da jagorar ƙaddamarwa na nesa. Shin jagorar tana ba da garantin adadin dawo da salincin? documents.text: Rahoto-kore ilimin membrane Vontron Cibiyar Ilimin Membrane: RO, NF da UF Aikace-aikace Yuchen Water Vontron mai rabawa ne kuma dillali. Muna ba da kayan membrane don ayyukan zama, kasuwanci da masana'antu kuma muna ba da tallafin fasaha na kayan aiki masu alaƙa. Wannan cibiyar tana bayanin nau'ikan membrane da aikace-aikace ba tare da tambayar masu siye su zaɓi samfurin samfur ba. Rahoton ruwa na yanzu ko tsari-ruwa, maƙasudin magani da taƙaitaccen aiki ya zo farko. Aika Rahoton Ruwa don Binciken Fasaha Jagororin ilimi masu alaƙa Daga rahoto zuwa tallafi mai gudana Rahoton ruwa ko tsari-ruwa Raba nazarin wakilci, ma'auni na samfur da bambancin. Ƙimar fasaha Yi bitar abubuwan gurɓatawa, ɓarna da haɗari, ƙimar manufa, fitarwa da yanayin aiki. Shawarar nau'in Membrane Gano madaidaiciyar RO, NF, UF, MBR, SW Series ko jagora na musamman kafin tabbatar da abu. Tallafin kayan aiki da kayan aiki Tabbatar da bayanin kayan aiki na yanzu kuma ku tattauna riga-kafi, gidaje, famfo, tacewa da sarrafawa. Taimakon bayarwa da bayan tallace-tallace Haɓaka wadatarwa, jagorar ƙaddamarwa mai nisa, tattaunawa mai aiki da shirin maye gurbin. Rukuni na membrane ta hanyar aikin jiyya Rukunin membrane suna bayyana matsayin rabuwa. Ba su zama masu maye gurbin rahoton ruwa ba ko shawarwarin abu na ƙarshe ba. Rukuni na membrane ta hanyar aikin jiyya Juya osmosis (RO) Ana la'akari da RO lokacin da ake buƙatar raguwar gishiri-gishiri mai faɗi ko ruwan samfur mafi girma. Ciyar da sinadarai, matsa lamba, pretreatment da kuma mayar da hankali yanayi suna bayyana iyaka mai amfani. Rukuni na membrane ta hanyar aikin jiyya Nanofiltration (NF) NF can support selective dissolved-species and organic separation. Dole ne a bayyana maƙasudin da aka riƙe da masu ratsawa, pH, zafin jiki da yanayin tsaftacewa. Rukuni na membrane ta hanyar aikin jiyya Ultrafiltration (UF) da MBR Matsayin UF da MBR yawanci suna mayar da hankali kan abubuwan da aka dakatar, colloidal da kayan halitta. Zasu iya zama shinge na ƙarshe ko pretreatment kafin matakan membrane mai ƙarfi. Rukuni na membrane ta hanyar aikin jiyya SW Series da ruwan gishiri RO Ruwan teku da aikace-aikacen ruwa na brackish suna buƙatar salinity, ion, zafin jiki, ci, pretreatment da babban matsi-kayan bita kafin zaɓin kayan. Hanyoyin aikace-aikace Fara daga tushen da nufin amfani. Kowace hanya tana kaiwa ga lissafin rahoton rahoto da tattaunawa ta fasaha, ba zuwa zaɓin ƙirar atomatik ba. Ruwan ruwa da ruwa mai laushi Yi bitar salinity, ions, zafin jiki, bambancin sha, haɗarin ilimin halitta, raɗaɗin manufa da ƙuntatawa. Ruwan karkashin kasa da ruwan rijiya Bincika taurin, alkalinity, silica, baƙin ƙarfe, manganese, gas, salinity da gurɓataccen gida. Municipal da shiri na ruwan sha Tabbatar da magungunan kashe kwayoyin cuta, kwayoyin halitta, tauri, maƙasudin dandano, kayan da ake buƙata da amfani da ƙasa. Sake amfani da ruwan sharar masana'antu Bayyana tsarin samarwa, sauye-sauye, kwayoyin halitta, mai, karafa, daskararru, sake amfani da makoma da tattara hankali. Babban-salinity da tallafi masu alaƙa da ZLD Samar da cikakkiyar ma'auni na ion, ƙananan haɗarin sikelin, kwayoyin halitta, sauye-sauye da rawar da ake nufi na matakin membrane. Gishiri-lake brine da ruwan da ke da alaƙa da lithium Fadi cikakken abun da ke ciki da makasudin rabuwa. Tallafin membrane-material ba alƙawarin cikakken tsarin cirewa ba ne ko sakamakon farfadowa. Abinci, abin sha, magunguna da ruwaye na musamman Ƙayyade abubuwan da aka riƙe, maƙasudin ingancin samfur, tsafta, pH, zafin jiki, tsaftacewa da buƙatun shaida. Kasuwancin wurin zama da haske Daidaita ruwan shigar da ruwa, buƙatu, matsa lamba, gine-gine mai tsarkakewa, riga-kafi da samun damar maye gurbin maimakon alamar iya aiki. Abin da za a haɗa a cikin taƙaitaccen fasaha tushen ruwa ko tsari-ruwa ainihi da wurin samfur cikakken rahoton dakin gwaje-gwaje na yanzu TDS ko conductivity da salinity inda ya dace pH da kewayon zafin jiki manyan ions, taurin, alkalinity, silica, baƙin ƙarfe da manganese turbidity, dakatar da daskararru, Organics da nazarin halittu Manuniya manufa samfurin ingancin ruwa ko manufar rabuwa fitarwa da ake buƙata da lokutan aiki na yau da kullun data kasance pretreatment da kayan aiki cikakkun bayanai sani tsaftacewa, maida hankali ko tsari ƙuntata Yadda Yuchen Water ke tallafawa aikin rahoton-ruwa da bita-maƙasudin tsari membrane-category da shawarwarin kayan aiki pretreatment da jituwa-bangaren tattaunawa Gidajen membrane, famfo, tacewa da tallafin sarrafawa wadatar kayan aiki da tabbatar da takaddun tallafi kwamishinonin nesa da jagorar aiki sauyawa da tsara kayan aiki Abubuwan da ke cikin gidan yanar gizon suna ba da ilimin fasaha na matakin rukuni. Ana buƙatar cikakken rahoto da tabbataccen taƙaitaccen aiki kafin abu na ƙarshe, kayan aiki ko yanke shawara na aiki. Yuchen Water baya da'awar kera Vontron membranes kuma baya yin alƙawarin juzu'i, farfadowa, rayuwa, zaɓi ko sakamakon aikin don rafi da ba a duba ba. Aika Rahoton Ruwa don Binciken Fasaha Aika rahoton ruwa ko tsari-ruwa, maƙasudin magani, fitarwa da ake buƙata da yanayin aiki. Yuchen Water zai sake duba jagorar nau'in membrane, iyakar samar da kayan aiki da tambayoyin tallafin kayan aiki masu alaƙa. Aika Rahoton Ruwa don Binciken Fasaha Jagororin ilimi masu alaƙa Albarkatu Yadda ake Zaɓi Tsakanin RO, NF da UF daga Rahoton Ruwa Koyi yadda kimiyyar ruwa-ruwa, burin jiyya da yanayin aiki ke jagorantar zaɓi tsakanin RO, NF da UF nau'ikan membrane. Karanta jagorar → Albarkatu Ruwan Teku da Jagoran Jiyya na Membrane-Ruwa Fahimtar bayanan rahoton, riga-kafi da tambayoyin kayan aiki waɗanda ke zuwa gabanin shawarwarin ruwan teku ko magudanar ruwa. Karanta jagorar → Albarkatu Jagoran Kula da Ruwan Ƙasa da Rijiyar Ruwa Shirya ruwan ƙasa da ruwa mai rijiyar jiyya daga cikakken nazarin ma'adanai, karafa, gas, kwayoyin halitta da manufofin aiki. Karanta jagorar → Albarkatu Sake Amfani da Ruwan Sharar Masana'antu: Matsayin UF, NF da RO Dubi yadda tarihin ruwan sharar gida, sake amfani da maƙasudi da haɗarin da aka riga aka yi amfani da su ke tantance matsayin UF, NF da RO a cikin aikin sake amfani da masana'antu. Karanta jagorar → Albarkatu Ruwan Sharar Ruwa mai-Salinity da ZLD Tallafin Membrane Shirya sinadarai, sauye-sauye da bayanan tsari-manufa da ake buƙata kafin yin magana akan kayan membrane don ruwan sha mai yawan gishiri ko tallafi mai alaƙa da ZLD. Karanta jagorar → Albarkatu Gishiri-Lake Brine da Ruwan da ke da alaƙa da Lithium: Bayanan Rahoton da ake buƙata Koyi abin da aka haɗa da bayanan tsari da ake buƙata kafin tattaunawa NF, RO ko UF kayan membrane don brine-tafkin gishiri da ruwan da ke da alaƙa da lithium. Karanta jagorar → Albarkatu Mazauna da Haske-Kasuwanci RO Ka'idodin Zaɓin Zaɓi Zaɓi kayan zama da haske-na kasuwanci RO kayan membrane daga ingancin ruwa, buƙatar yau da kullun, dacewa da kayan aiki da yanayin sabis maimakon alamar samfuri. Karanta jagorar → Albarkatu Yadda Kunna Maganin Carbon Ke Kare RO Membrane Fahimtar yadda carbon da aka kunna zai iya tallafawa oxidant da sarrafa kwayoyin kafin RO, kuma me yasa zaɓin carbon har yanzu ya dogara da nazarin ruwa da yanayin tsarin. Karanta jagorar → Yadda Kunna Maganin Carbon Ke Kare RO Membrane Jagororin ilimi masu alaƙa Fahimtar yadda carbon da aka kunna zai iya tallafawa oxidant da sarrafa kwayoyin kafin RO, kuma me yasa zaɓin carbon har yanzu ya dogara da nazarin ruwa da yanayin tsarin. Karanta jagorar → An bayar da hanyar haɗin kan hukuma a matsayin babban tunani don nau'ikan membrane na yanzu da takaddun. Bayanan samfur na iya canzawa, don haka ana tabbatar da ainihin kayan aiki da takaddun hukuma na yanzu yayin bita na fasaha. Vontron official industrial membrane overview · Vontron official UF membrane overview Tambayoyin da ake yawan yi Me yasa Yuchen Water ke neman rahoton ruwa kafin bayar da shawarar membrane? Saboda sunaye masu tushe da TDS ba sa siffanta duk ƙima, ɓarna, dacewa da haɗarin manufa-jiyya. Shin cibiyar ilimin ta maye gurbin nazarin injiniya? A'a. Yana taimaka wa masu siye su shirya ingantaccen bayani; Shawarar ƙarshe ta biyo bayan rahoto da duba yanayin aiki. Shin Yuchen Water na iya ba da tallafin kayan aiki da kayan membrane? Ee. Babban wadata shine kayan aikin membrane, tare da goyon bayan da suka danganci pretreatment, gidaje, famfo, tacewa, sarrafawa, jagorar ƙaddamarwa da shirin maye gurbin.

documents.headings: Jagorar sayen matatar ruwa ta OEM Ƙayyade abin da ake buƙata Binciki mai samarwa Kwatanta bayanan fasaha Tabbatar da marufin OEM da fitarwa
documents.text: Jagorar mai saye Jagorar sayen matatar ruwa ta OEM Jagora ga masu shigo da kaya da masu rarrabawa wajen kwatanta katirijin matata, tsarin RO na gida, da sarrafa ruwan kasuwanci ko masana’antu. Kayayyaki Tuntuɓa Ƙayyade abin da ake buƙata Bayyana ruwan da ke shiga, yanayin amfani da katirijin sauyawa. PP yana riƙe da laka; CTO da GAC suna rage chlorine tare da inganta ɗanɗano da wari; T33 yana inganta ɗanɗano a matakin ƙarshe. Ga UF da RO, kwatanta ƙarfin aiki, matakai, gidajen matata da kayan gyara. Ga masana’antu, bayyana gyaran ruwa na farko, matsin membrane da kwararar ruwan da ya ratsa membrane. Ƙayyade tazarar lokacin sauya matatun. Ga tsarin RO na masana’antu, ku amince da tsarin membrane, matsin lamba yayin aiki da matakin sarrafa kansa. Binciki mai samarwa Nemi bayanan fasaha, ƙarfin samarwa, kula da ingancin kowane rukuni da marufin fitarwa. Duba sanarwar kayan da aka yi amfani da su, rahoton gwaji, hotunan masana’anta da amincewar samfurori. Takardar shaida ta dace da takamaiman kaya, oda da kasuwar da za a kai; takarda ɗaya ba ta tabbatar da dukkan samfura ba. Kwatanta bayanan fasaha Ga katiriji, duba girma, ƙimar micron, kayan tacewa, murfin ƙarshen, zoben hana zubewa, kwarara da tsawon amfani. Ga RO, duba membrane, famfo, maɓallan matsin lamba, bawulolin solenoid, na’urar sarrafawa, ƙarfin lantarki, tanki da kayan gyara. Ga masana’antu, kwatanta tankuna, matatun yashi da carbon, rage taurin ruwa, tace ƙananan ƙwayoyin datti, famfon matsin lamba mai yawa, gidajen membrane, ma’aunin ƙarfin ruwan na gudanar da lantarki (conductivity), bawuloli masu sarrafa kansu, CIP da kariyar lantarki. Daidaita tsarin da ruwa, wurin aiki da kulawa. Tabbatar da kayan da aka yi zoben hana zubewa da su, hanyar marufin katiriji, samfurin membrane na RO, zaɓin famfo, zaɓuɓɓukan tanki da tsarin sauya matata. Tsaftacewar CIP zaɓi ne a tsarin kayan aikin da ake buƙatar tabbatarwa dabam. Tabbatar da marufin OEM da fitarwa Kafin samarwa, tabbatar da alamomin OEM/ODM, launi, tambari, zane, littafin umarni da alamar kasuwanci ta musamman tare da Yuchen Water. Yarda kan kwalaye, pallet ko akwatunan katako, tashar jirgin ruwa da takardu. Amince da samfurori da shirin sauyawa da kayan gyara; kada a kwatanta farashi kaɗai. Tabbatar da girman kwalayen kwali da yadda za a ɗora kaya a kan pallet. Aika nau’in kaya, yawa, ƙasar da za a kai da buƙatun keɓancewa. Tabbatar da bayanan fasaha da takardun ƙarshe kafin oda.
